purpose: Local registry and public parcel-geometry source review. Queries were separated by English and local language. No owner, address, tax, or private property fields were queried or retained.
assessment: The official Saran district land-records service is linked from the Collectorate in Chapra. Bihar BhuNaksha exposes district/subdivision/circle/mauza/survey/map-sheet selectors; the statewide browser is designed for revenue map viewing, while cadastral edits are for authorized officials. No Chapra urban mauza, point extent or safe full-polygon geometry response was established here. Bihar’s public Revenue Map viewer and land-record pages are the relevant local pathway. No full polygon was returned; geometry presence remains unverified.
